Dear all,

In order to test the proportional hazard assumption, I want to fit a Cox PH model for survival data, where I can include an interaction term with time, like the function tt does in the package survival in the function coxph. Can I do that within the term f() in the function inla ? Do you have any idea about how can I add this interaction ?

Thank you,
Edwige
